No evidence of persistence, defense impairment, or credential theft was observed across all analysis tools. The sample is compiled with MinGW-w64 using GNU C99 16.1.0, as evidenced by compiler strings in the binary (source: FLOSS strings, malcat top strings). All behavioral intent signals are corroborated across IDA, Ghidra, Malcat, capa, and YARA analysis, with no indications of benign functionality.
